tested_with.status_reason: Leaf-id mapping {2,3}=programado, {5,6,7}=espontâneo covers 100% of tb_fat_atendimento_individual across the full observed history on both validated installations: PEC 5.4.37 on CT 133 (2023-07-03 to 2026-04-30, 294114 rows) and PEC 5.5.28 on the municipal production host (2023-07-03 to 2026-08-31, 326627 rows). Ids 8, 9, 10, 11 of tb_dim_tipo_atendimento never occur on this instance and remain NOT_TESTED — if a future extraction encounters them, the run must raise a limitation rather than silently classifying them.

municipal_isolation_evidence.mechanism: WHERE clause parameterized on co_ibge (7-digit text), never on the installation-local surrogate co_seq_dim_municipio. tb_dim_municipio is a shared national reference table (1870 rows), not partitioned per installation; single-municipality-per-row is a property of this data, not assumed structurally.

tested_with.test_notes: Validated twice, independently: (1) live against the production PEC on CT 133 through the actual adapter code, reproducing 7100 programados / 2929 espontaneos / 0 fora / 10029 total for competencia 2026-03, byte-identical to the psql baseline, and again end-to-end through a full acquire-extract-disconnect-recompute cycle (ENG-19). (2) against a synthetic Testcontainers postgres:9.6 fixture (fixture_checksum above) with two municipalities that deliberately share the same unidade/equipe/cbo surrogate ids, proving the join binds on tb_dim_municipio.co_ibge and not on any installation-local key (ENG-37, ENG-38). (3) PEC 5.5.28 added 2026-09-24: live against the municipal production PEC 5.5.28 / PostgreSQL 9.6.13, all seven signature_fingerprints recomputed byte-identical twice — by JdbcCompatibilityCatalog over JDBC and by ExecPlaneAcquisition from the Rust execution plane's own probe — and competencia 2026-03 acquired end-to-end through the Rust child (10029 rows, 0 exclusions).

tested_with.status_reason: Aggregate count of tb_fat_atendimento_individual per tb_dim_municipio.co_ibge within one competência (ADR 0023).

municipal_isolation_evidence.mechanism: No municipality parameter: the query groups the competência's atendimentos by co_ibge and Java compares each group with the source's registered IBGE. objects_used are byte-identical copies of individual_encounter_modality's, so REQUIRED_DIMENSIONS still fails closed on any fact row without a tb_dim_municipio row.

tested_with.test_notes: Validated 2026-09-28 live against the municipal production PEC 5.5.28 / PostgreSQL 9.6.13 through an SSH tunnel, with this entry marked VALIDATED locally and the execution plane rebuilt from it (ADR 0023): ExecPlaneLivePecTest isolation case CHECKED for competencia 2026-03, counts [3541307=10029] byte-identical to the same frozen query over JDBC, 2.5 s; the same run re-checked all seven signature_fingerprints (identical) and acquired 2026-03 end-to-end (10029 rows, 0 exclusions). The app itself (POST /sources/{id}/isolation-check) answered CHECKED with registeredCount 10029, otherMunicipalityCount 0, unidentifiedCount 0.

tested_with.status_reason: Aggregate count of tb_fat_atendimento_individual per (tb_dim_municipio.co_ibge, yyyy-MM of tb_dim_tempo.dt_registro) within a window of competências (ADR 0027).

municipal_isolation_evidence.mechanism: No municipality parameter: the query groups the window's atendimentos by co_ibge and month, and Java keeps only the source's registered IBGE. objects_used are byte-identical copies of individual_encounter_modality's, so REQUIRED_DIMENSIONS still fails closed on any fact row without a tb_dim_municipio row.

tested_with.test_notes: Validated 2026-09-30 live against the municipal production PEC 5.5.28 / PostgreSQL 9.6.13 through an SSH tunnel, with this entry marked VALIDATED locally and the execution plane rebuilt from it (ADR 0023 recipe): ExecPlaneLivePecTest coverage case CHECKED for the window 2024-09..2026-10 (exclusive), 24 (co_ibge, month) groups, all 3541307, byte-identical to the same frozen query over JDBC, 4.5 s; competencia 2026-03 = 10029, the same total every earlier evidence counted.

municipal_isolation_evidence.mechanism: Filtro tb_dim_municipio.co_ibge = bind de município (texto de 7 dígitos), ligado pelo co_dim_municipio do próprio fato; as tabelas-filhas (problemas, exames, procedimentos, doses, participantes) usam o município do cabeçalho. Nunca a chave substituta co_seq_dim_municipio, nunca o município de nascimento do cadastro. A coluna municipality_ibge devolve o co_ibge filtrado. Isolamento provado só na fixture (dois municípios com as mesmas chaves substitutas, CapabilityQueriesIsolationTest).
